annotations.text:
Four directions for the fasting timer — the screen you'll look at most.
Same content in all four, so you're judging the look and nothing else.
Pick one (or parts of several) and I'll build the remaining screens in it.

A · QUIET INSTRUMENT
Near-black, one cool accent, thin ring, mono numerals. Reads like a measuring device — the fast is data, not a mood.
Tradeoff: safe. Handsome but won't surprise you.

B · WARM EDITORIAL
Warm ink and cream, serif throughout, lowercase times. Fasting as a considered practice rather than a metric.
Tradeoff: serif numerals are slower to read at a glance.

C · DATA BRUTALIST
Hard edges, zero radius, acid accent, huge type. Everything on one screen, no scrolling, glanceable at arm's length.
Tradeoff: loud. Lives on your home screen all day.

D · SOFT CIRCADIAN
Deep indigo with a dawn-warm accent, rounded, generous. Closest to a modern health app.
Tradeoff: the most familiar — you've seen this shape before.
